resources.string: WebPOS in Chrome can print and take NFC payments on http://127.0.0.1:9101
Return to WebPOS in Chrome — sales work without printing; refresh when Bridge is ready.
Tap Set default on the printer you want WebPOS to use. Use Test on any row to verify that printer.
Printer connection closed too early. Try Test on the specific printer row, or re-pair Bluetooth.
Bluetooth permission required. Allow Nearby devices for Bridge Reborn in Android Settings, then try again.
No printers found yet. Connect USB or pair Bluetooth, or add a LAN IP.
Runs Bridge Reborn in the background after every restart and reconnects USB, Bluetooth, and Wi‑Fi printers.
Bridge Reborn will start automatically after reboot
Bridge Reborn will not start after reboot until you open this app
Your %1$s device may stop Bridge Reborn unless battery and autostart are configured.
Could not open that settings screen. Open App info manually in Android Settings.
WebPOS in Chrome needs Bridge Reborn running in the background for printing and NFC payments. These quick steps stop Android from closing Bridge after reboot or when you switch apps.
Allow Bridge Reborn to run without battery limits. Tap the button below and choose Allow or Unrestricted when prompted.
Battery restriction is already disabled for Bridge Reborn.
Battery restriction is still active. Tap Allow unrestricted battery, then return here.
On Sunmi devices, open Autostart management and enable Bridge Reborn so it starts automatically after reboot.
On Feitian devices, open App info for Bridge Reborn, then set Battery to Unrestricted and allow background activity if shown.
Open your device\'s autostart or startup manager and enable Bridge Reborn. This prevents the system from blocking Bridge Reborn after reboot.
Open recent apps, find Bridge Reborn, then tap the lock icon (or pull down) so Android does not close it when clearing other apps.
Bridge Reborn runs as a foreground service on port 9101. Tap Start below — we verify WebPOS can reach it before you continue.
Bridge is running (version %1$s). WebPOS can print and take NFC payments.
Bridge is not responding yet. Tap Start Bridge service, then wait a few seconds.
Bridge did not respond. Check notification permission, then tap Start Bridge service again.
Sign in to WebPOS in Chrome on this tablet, then go to Settings → Payments and tap “Activate Tap to Pay on this device”. This registers the tablet with Adyen (one time).
Tap to Pay activated on this device.
Not activated yet — complete setup in WebPOS Settings → Payments.
Tap to open Bridge Reborn and finish setup
Bridge Reborn is configured to run in the background. Open WebPOS in Chrome — it will connect automatically. You can reopen this wizard anytime from the main screen.
Adyen SDK: bundled in this APK
Adyen SDK: not in this APK (print-only build)
